desc:
🍔 Oh no, the evil baker has taken control over the bakery! He's starting to go crazy and he is turning people into donuts!

⚙️ Will you be able to beat the obstacles and reach safety? ⚙️

⭐ If you've enjoyed this game and want more similar games, please show your support by liking and favoriting!

👍 Give the game a thumbs up for more exciting obbies! 👍

📌 This is a remake of the iconic "Escape the Bakery Obby," created by PlatinumFalls in 2016 and taken down in 2020. I’ve brought it back to honor the original and share its nostalgia with others.

[TAGS]: Obby, Cartoon-style, Fun, Adventure, Escape, Restaurant, Sewer, Survival, Challenge, diner, barry, bakery, evil, baker
